description: Runs ready tasks one step at a time on a single thread and wakes waiting tasks when their timers or I/O complete.
The object returned by calling an `async def` function: a paused computation that runs only when awaited or scheduled.
A coroutine scheduled on the loop; it runs concurrently with other tasks and can be awaited or cancelled.
Tasks switch only at an `await` that waits; code between two awaits is never interrupted by another task.
A call that does not yield, such as `time.sleep` or a synchronous HTTP client; it freezes every task on the loop.
